SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 74 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/74/2023/202 Dated 20-11-2023
GSTIN: 27BBBCB5678B1Z2 M/s Zenith Logistics
FY: 2018-19

1. Whereas during audit for FY 2018-19, it was noticed that taxpayer claimed ITC of Rs. 5,00,000/- in GSTR-3B filed on 10th December 2019.
2. The Proper Officer alleges that taxpayer suppressed facts with intent to evade tax and invokes extended period under Section 74(1).
